data.content:
## [As a trade professional](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a1dd8656da5d8eadd97584f)
As a trade professional, I have to say this is probably the WORST customer service I have ever received from any vendor that resells product EVER. We purchase in bulk for our clients, and consistently place large orders for new construction clients. That said, sometimes it's easier to buy from sites like this to consolidate the time and vendor correspondence with all of the wholesale vendors that they carry (most of which we do have direct accounts with). IN general, it can save our clients' freight charges, and keep it simplified. That said, GOD FORBID if you have any problems with an order or need any support whatsoever. Their website says they offer dedicated trade support, but it is a miserable and infuriating loop of text messages and emails, with no dedicated help or phone number to call. I am now on day 10 of trying to get an actual human to respond to a nuanced issue with our payment, to no avail. We finally had to contact AMEX to dispute our entire order since we were completely incapable of receiving any support. I cannot understand how a company that is this large and forward-facing would be so lacking in this arena. Other companies like Pottery Barn, RH, and Crate and Barrel all have full dedicated teams that will go out of their way to not only help but bend over backwards since we will literally spend thousands quarterly with their brands. I shudder to think how much worse it would be as a regular consumer to deal with this brand. I'm experiencing literal text rage trying to deal with them. its JUST NOT WORTH IT. Use google reverse image for any of the items they sell, none of which are generally exclusive to them as they are resellers, and find a better source with actual customer service support so that you have a chance at dealing with any potential concern that may arise from your purchase. TRUST ME.. you do not want to experience being on the wrong side of a purchase from this company.

June 1, 2026
